Class Card

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsoft.mesos.server.model.game.cards.Card
All Implemented Interfaces:
CardAction
Direct Known Subclasses:
BuildingCard, TribeCard
public abstract class Card extends Object implements CardAction
Shared base class for every card in the model.

Each card has a stable identifier and belongs to one era. Concrete subclasses provide the rules that determine whether the card can be drawn and what gameplay behavior it triggers.
